comparison: Murray Theorem 1, PDF12. Same ideal-map extension criterion for injectivity. mathlib allows noncommutative rings; commutative specialization is appropriate. Universe Small hypothesis can be satisfied by choosing the module/ring universe together. Does not cover graded Baer or Bass numbers.
Barrett Theorem 1.1.3, PDF8. Same radical as intersection of minimal primes; order-theoretic sInf represents ideal intersection. mathlib even permits a commutative semiring.

Affine Nullstellensatz background invoked by Barrett PDF25. Finite variable set, fields k and algebraically closed extension K. For the usual affine version take K=k algebraically closed. No toric Cox-ring equality follows automatically.
Related to Heitzman PDF8,19,23: compact domain, equicontinuous continuous family, values in one compact subset of a T2 pseudometric space, compact closure. Does not cover noncontinuous PVO families.

Lax–Milgram background invoked by Mu PDF44,86,133. Real complete Hilbert space and bounded coercive bilinear form; inverse equivalence is the Riesz-represented solution map. Does not identify dissertation Sobolev spaces, prove trace estimates, or establish the saddle-point/FSI generator.

Finite-type graded algebra has a sufficiently divisible Veronese generated in degree one. No Bass-number, Matlis-duality or differential-operator conclusion; do not credit Murray or Lieberman main results.

Ordinary Veronese tangent-space defect classification over a characteristic-zero nontrivially normed field. Related to Zamir background Theorem2.1 PDF14. Not the weighted P(1,2,3) theorem; geometric tangent-space-to-secant identification needs separate bridges. Source inspected, not kernel-checked here.

The conclusion requires hgeneric, a dimension inequality for the tangent cone of the secant set; also requires local parametrizations over a normed field. It is not an unconditional proof of Zamir weighted secant/interpolation equivalence.

Seifert-matrix invariant and algebraic identities; file expressly leaves producing a matrix from a classical knot and comparison with other routes as separate work. No Wright complete-neighbor obstruction.
Grid-diagram quotient/cross-commutation distance and basic bounds, not Wright five classical knot lower bounds or complete-neighbor conjectures.
Minimum size of a maximal matching; different from forbidden-subgraph saturation sat_H(n,F) in Volk.
Global smooth original Navier–Stokes statement ends in sorry. Not a proved calmed-system theorem; forced-breakdown proof metadata does not establish this statement.
